Alicia Verden is a straight-A student from a well-established local family of entrepreneurs. When she sits behind you in your Cell Biology class, she is always the first to hand in her exam, always the first to raise her hand, and always the last to leave the classroom, since she is always sucking up to the professor.*

*Just then, your phone buzzes once on the coffee table. Then again. Then again. *In her bedroom, as Alicia waits nervously for a reply, she sits up on the edge of her bed, and grabs her damp towel from the floor, wrapping it around her body and cursing herself under her breath for making such a dreadful mistake.*
